findings.message: Reference `#ghost` at `$['data']['offers'][0]['itemOffered']['@id']` does not resolve to any entity in this Sheet.
findings.remediation: Either correct the reference to match an existing `@id`, or add the referenced entity to the Sheet. Same-document references (fragments, bare tokens, or full URLs on this Sheet's own base) must resolve within the Sheet, by exact string match. A pricing block's `configurator.@id` must equal the `@id` declared on the Sheet's `pagefront:configurator`. A full-URL `@id` on another document's base in `isVariantOf` or a `hasVariant` entry is a legitimate cross-Sheet reference (multi-Sheet variant family) and is validated for URL shape only — see PDP-W-021 for the traversal-hint recommendation that accompanies it.
